# NeoIntelli

> AI GCC Operating Partner in India. NeoIntelli designs, builds, hires, enables, operates and scales AI Global Capability Centers (GCCs) in India for companies headquartered in the US, the UK and Europe. Start with an AI Micro GCC of one squad, build a full capability center, or transform an existing GCC so AI adoption turns into measurable business value.

Headquarters: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Contact: reachus@neointelli.com
LinkedIn: https://in.linkedin.com/company/neointelli

One AI GCC. Multiple operating engines: AI Advisory & GCC Design, GCC Setup & Operations, Recruitment Hub + NeoHireX Hiring OS, People & HR Operations, Workspace, IT & Security, AI Infrastructure & GPU, Data, GenAI & AI Engineering, MLOps, AgentOps & AI Governance, and Scale, BOT & Ownership (Managed, EOR-first, Build-Operate-Transfer, Captive).

## AI Engineering

NeoIntelli designs and engineers production AI systems across Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning and data, from proof of value through production to permanent capability. This is a different question from AI GCC: AI Engineering asks whether NeoIntelli can design and build an AI capability for a company; AI GCC asks what capabilities an India capability center should own.

- [Enterprise AI Engineering](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-engineering) - Enterprise AI engineering overview: what AI engineering is, the three kinds of AI, the proof of value to production to capability lifecycle, build/buy/integrate decisions
- [Generative & Agentic AI](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-engineering/generative-agentic-ai) - Generative and Agentic AI engineering: enterprise RAG, copilots, agents, tool calling, MCP where relevant, evaluation, guardrails, human escalation
- [Applied AI & Machine Learning](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-engineering/applied-ai-ml) - Applied AI and machine learning: forecasting, prediction, optimization, recommendation, anomaly detection, computer vision, NLP, ML evaluation
- [AI Data Engineering](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-engineering/data-engineering) - AI-ready data engineering: pipelines, lakehouse, governed data products, document pipelines, vector and hybrid retrieval, evaluation datasets
- [AI Product Engineering](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-engineering/ai-product-engineering) - AI product engineering: AI-native products, AI features in SaaS, copilots, semantic search, recommendations, AI UX, cost per interaction
- [AI Agents & Automation](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-engineering/ai-agents-automation) - Enterprise AI agents and workflow automation: deterministic, AI-assisted and agentic layers, permissions, human-in-the-loop, AgentOps
- [MLOps, LLMOps & AgentOps](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-engineering/mlops-llmops-agentops) - Production MLOps, LLMOps and AgentOps: versioning, evaluation gates, deployment, tracing, observability, rollback, AI FinOps
- [AI Evaluation & Assurance](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-engineering/ai-evaluation-assurance) - AI evaluation and assurance: golden datasets, RAG and agent evaluation, groundedness, red teaming, production monitoring

## AI Delivery Teams

NeoIntelli provides AI execution capacity as embedded engineering teams that work inside the client's roadmap, repositories and delivery cadence. Four engagement models sit under one category. Team configurations (GenAI and Agentic AI, applied ML, data, production AI, AI product, AI evaluation) are shapes of these models rather than separate services.

- [AI Delivery Teams](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-delivery-teams) - Category page: dedicated teams, delivery pods, forward-deployed engineers, build and transfer, plus a model-selection framework
- [Dedicated AI Engineering Team](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-delivery-teams/dedicated-ai-engineering-team) - A stable AI engineering team aligned to one ongoing client roadmap
- [AI Delivery Pod](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-delivery-teams/ai-delivery-pod) - A cross-functional unit organised around one defined AI outcome, with a written pod charter
- [Forward-Deployed AI Engineers](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-delivery-teams/forward-deployed-ai-engineers) - Engineers embedded in client product, engineering and business environments to move AI from pilot to production
- [AI Team Build & Transfer](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-delivery-teams/ai-team-transfer) - Deliver now, then transfer knowledge and ownership to an internal team, Micro GCC or AI GCC

## AI Talent

Technically validated AI talent: specialist recruiters, the NeoHireX Hiring OS (AI screening, ranking, AI first-round interviews, pipeline and evaluation record) and practitioner-led technical validation. NeoHireX does not make hiring decisions; the client does. When one hire becomes a team, the engagement can become an AI Micro GCC or AI GCC.

- [AI, ML & Data Talent Services in India](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-talent) - Hub: one critical hire, an AI team, an AI Recruitment Hub or an AI GCC; the eight-step "We interview. You hire." validation flow
- [AI & ML Recruitment](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-talent/ai-ml-recruitment) - AI engineers, ML engineers, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, research engineers, data scientists, AI solution architects
- [GenAI & Agentic AI Hiring](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-talent/genai-agentic-ai-hiring) - GenAI, LLM, RAG, agentic AI, AI agent, AI application, AI systems and forward deployed engineers; GenAI and agentic architects; what we test
- [Data Engineering & Data Science Hiring](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-talent/data-engineering-data-science-hiring) - Data, analytics, platform and streaming engineers, data architects, data and applied scientists, AI data engineers
- [MLOps & AI Platform Hiring](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-talent/mlops-ai-platform-hiring) - MLOps, ML and AI platform, AI infrastructure, LLMOps, AgentOps, GPU infrastructure, AI DevSecOps
- [AI Leadership & Executive Search](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-talent/ai-leadership-executive-search) - Chief AI Officer, Head of AI, VP AI and Data, AI directors, distinguished architects, GCC AI heads
- [AI Recruitment Hub + NeoHireX](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-talent/recruitment-hub) - Dedicated recruitment POD, Hiring OS and technical validation for 10 to 100+ technical hires (RPO and managed hiring)
- [AI Talent Academy & Reskilling](https://neointelli.com/services/ai-talent/ai-reskilling-academy) - Convert backend, data, DevOps, ML, QA and architecture engineers into validated AI roles
- [Contract & Contract-to-Hire](https://neointelli.com/recruitment/contract-staffing) - Contract and C2H engagement model
- [GCC Workforce Strategy](https://neointelli.com/services/gcc-operations/workforce-strategy) - Workforce planning, leadership architecture, capability development and retention for a GCC
- [NeoHireX](https://neohirex.ai/) - NeoIntelli's AI hiring platform

## GCC Operations

NeoIntelli runs and scales India GCCs through one accountable operating layer (GCC Operations & Managed Services) while the client retains the mandate, product, IP, data and hiring decisions. Managed operations can move to Build-Operate-Transfer and then to captive ownership.

- [GCC Operations & Managed Services](https://neointelli.com/services/gcc-operations) - GCC operations and managed services overview
- [People & HR Operations](https://neointelli.com/services/gcc-operations/people-hr-operations) - People and HR operations for India GCCs

- [Service Management & Performance](https://neointelli.com/services/gcc-operations/service-management-performance) - Service management, KPIs and GCC performance
- [Governance & Compliance](https://neointelli.com/services/gcc-operations/governance-compliance) - GCC governance, risk and compliance operations

## Disambiguation

"GCC" on this site always means Global Capability Center (an India-based capability center owned by a global company). It does not refer to the Gulf Cooperation Council region. "AI GCC" means a GCC designed to own and operate AI, data and AI-enabled engineering capabilities. "AI Micro GCC" means a dedicated India AI capability of roughly 8 to 50 people running on the same operating model as a full GCC.
